_comment: Offline mock only: what Claude returns for each ticket. 'v1_mistakes' are the systematic errors a zero-shot prompt makes; prompts that contain <examples> (v2) get the corrected output.

T-1001.summary: Customer was charged twice ($49.00) for March invoice INV-3391 and asks for the duplicate charge to be refunded.

T-1002.summary: Since 09:10 about 140 users cannot log in; SSO returns HTTP 500 after the Okta redirect and production work is blocked.

T-1005.summary: Customer asks how to export a dashboard to PDF; only CSV export is visible.

T-1006.summary: After moving from the Pro to the Team plan the customer was billed for both plans this month and wants the invoice corrected.

T-1007.summary: Customer requests erasure of all personal data under GDPR Article 17; a verification phone number was provided (redacted).

T-1008.summary: Since the 5.2 mobile update the customer reports six separate defects affecting 12 field staff who use the app daily: a crash when opening the Reports tab on Android 15 (Pixel 8), push notifications delayed by 20-40 minutes, unreadable table headers in dark mode, duplicated entries after offline edits are synced, background battery drain rising from about 4% to 15% per hour, and a forced logout every morning despite 'remember me'. Each defect likely needs its own engineering ticket; the crash and the sync duplication are the most severe because they block work or corrupt data.
key_facts: battery drain 4% -> 15% per hour in background

T-1009.summary: Integration receives HTTP 429 responses while staying under the documented limit of 100 requests per minute; customer orders are queuing.

T-1010.summary: Renewal payment failed three times with card_declined_do_not_honor although the bank reports no block; renewal deadline is Friday.

T-1011.summary: Asks whether a nonprofit discount exists; also mentions the app felt slow yesterday.
